content.value: The vertical 0.8 m high, 2 m wide double-pane window consists of two sheets of glass separated by a 2 cm air gap at atmospheric pressure. If the glass surface temperatures across the air gap are measured to be $1 2 ^ { \circ } \mathrm { C }$ and $2 ^ { \circ } C$ determine the rate of heat transfer through the window.
